goals: Every specimen traceable from incoming inspection to the fracture surface//Jede Probe von der Eingangsprüfung bis zur Bruchfläche nachvollziehbar

Per test series, visible at a glance which specimen is in which workflow step and what comes next//Pro Prüfserie auf einen Blick sichtbar, welche Probe in welchem Ablaufschritt steht und was als Nächstes kommt
Every measured value and every file has a unique location ('what belongs where')//Jeder Messwert und jede Datei hat einen eindeutigen Ort („wo gehört was hin")
Data machine-evaluable later (S-N curve from the series table, parser for IMC raw data)//Daten später maschinell auswertbar (Wöhlerlinie aus der Serientabelle, Parser für IMC-Rohdaten)

principles.name: Flat object hierarchy//Flache Objekt-Hierarchie
principles.rule: Space -> Project -> Collection (= test series) -> Objects. Experimental steps hang directly on the specimen (exactly one parent-child level). No step->step chains. All objects of a series live in the series collection.

principles.name: Flat type hierarchy//Flache Typ-Hierarchie
principles.rule: New types inherit directly from an existing BAM base class; no own intermediate levels. As few new types as possible.

principles.name: Specimen data on the specimen//Probendaten an die Probe
principles.rule: Properties describing the specimen (distortion, geometry, weld rating, load level) are properties of the specimen -> the collection table is the test matrix.

principles.name: Activities with device/file = experimental step//Tätigkeiten mit Gerät/Datei = Versuchsschritt
principles.rule: A separate step object only where device(s), time period, operator and files belong together. Several workflow steps at the same workplace are combined into one object with numbered sections.

principles.name: Workflow plan visible//Ablaufplan sichtbar
principles.rule: Sections carry the step number (e.g. '07 DMS-Applikation'). Every specimen has a 'Next step' field (ordered choice list 01-12 + completed). An SOP object 'Ablaufplan' in the project describes all steps and storage locations.

principles.name: Reuse-first//Reuse-first
principles.rule: Reuse devices, auxiliary materials, standard steps, collection and dataset types from bam-masterdata. Live-existing, non-standardised types are not reused but migrated into the standard.

principles.name: Lean properties//Lean Properties
principles.rule: Tables (load programme, beach marks, measurement series) are files, not properties.

principles.name: Language per BAM convention//Sprache nach BAM-Konvention
principles.rule: Descriptions bilingual "English//Deutsch" (no spaces around //); property_label and section names in English as in the rest of bam-masterdata.

series.definition: One test series = one Collection (e.g. 'Serie 1 – Stumpfstoß', 'Serie 1 – Kreuzstoß')//Eine Prüfserie = eine Collection (z. B. „Serie 1 – Stumpfstoß", „Serie 1 – Kreuzstoß")
series.notes: PRD: '(Letztere über den Versuchsschritt)' - the latter columns (number of cycles, termination reason) come via the experimental step. 'Bewertungsgruppe' does not specify whether the target (§4) or the Annex C rating (step 04) is meant.

domain_decisions.decision: Extend the existing BAM vocabulary WELDING.WELD_TYPE with BUTT_WELD 'Butt weld//Stumpfstoß' and CRUCIFORM_WELD 'Cruciform weld//Kreuzstoß'
Devices and auxiliary materials are created once in the inventory and linked as parents of experimental steps (not as free text)
No project-specific catalog types for strain gauges or adhesives
One test series = one Collection; the collection table shows the per-specimen columns listed in series.table_columns
Every specimen has a 'Next step//Nächster Schritt' field: ordered choice list 01-12 + completed
One SOP object 'Ablaufplan' (workflow plan) in the project describes all steps and storage locations; sections carry the step number (e.g. '07 DMS-Applikation')

deliverables: generated/<stem>/requirements.json and gap-report.md (REUSE / EXTEND / CREATE / LIVE-ONLY)
generated/<stem>/datamodel/ - PR-ready bam-masterdata classes only for CREATE; EXTEND as PR instructions
Provisioning on the dev1 training instance (masterdata + demo series), notebook for repetition
Parser scaffold for steps 10/11 (IMC raw data -> experimental step)
